2.50.31
Matrix.MatrixRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.MatrixRows element specifies the collection of rows contained in each detail cell of a
matrix layout. This element MUST be specified. The Matrix.MatrixRows element is of type
MatrixRows.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.MatrixRows element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.MatrixRows element.
 <xsd:element name="MatrixRows" type="MatrixRowsType" />
